up: Find all compounds referenced in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5729568 that also have a canonical SMILES structure recorded in the database. For each qualifying compound, return its ChEMBL identifier (chembl_id), its preferred name (pref_name), and the canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles). Exclude any compounds that lack a canonical SMILES.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5729568' AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL ORDER BY md.chembl_id
